scritte.Parla, o scrivi. Le cose che vuoi fare r: Speak, or write. The things you want to do stay here and don’t get lost, and each day closes like a circle.
scritte.Niente account, niente da pagare. Resta: No account, nothing to pay. Everything stays on your phone.
scritte.cosa vuoi fare?: what do you want to do?
scritte.qui si scrive a lungo: this is where you write at length

scritte.Senza chiave l’app si chiama Sentiero: Without a key the app is called Sentiero
scritte.e funziona per intero: diario, cose da f: and it works in full: diary, things to do, routines, the ring, the evening room, the grounding call, and the evening line written by the in‑house engine from your own days. No connection needed, and it costs nothing.
scritte.Con la chiave diventa Sentiero — version: With a key it becomes Sentiero — Generative version.
scritte.Le quest nascono dal parlato con giorno: Things to do are born from your speech with day and time; in the morning there is the fruit; the grounding call writes its question from your recent days instead of drawing it from a fixed set; the evening line is written by a model. You pay for the usage yourself, directly to Anthropic.
scritte.Una differenza che è giusto tu sappia pr: One difference you should know before choosing: when you write something heavy on a given day, the Generative version
scritte.e cambia registro; senza chiave l’app ri: and changes register; without a key the app only recognises phrases that cannot be misread, and catches about half of them.
scritte.La «Canzone di base» suona in loop duran: The “base song” loops while you use the app (max 8 MB). The others are one‑off slots (max 2 MB); silence by default. If you use the base song, it is better to turn off “Adaptive soundtrack” above. Everything stays on this phone only.
scritte.per attivare in un colpo gli 8 livelli i: to switch on all 8 built‑in levels plus the seal at once (nothing to download). Or load your own: up to 8 levels of rising intensity — combo 1 plays the first, and so on up the scale. The seal has its own sound. They stay on this phone only.
scritte.Quello che scrivi resta su questo telefo: What you write stays on this phone. There is no server receiving it, because there is no server: nobody reads it, not even the person who made the app. No account, no advertising, no analytics.
scritte.Escono dal telefono tre cose sole, e son: Only three things leave this phone, and these are they. When you open the address, GitHub — which hosts the app — sees your IP address, as any website would; once installed, the app runs without a connection. When you speak, it is your browser's own dictation that turns voice into text, and depending on the phone it may do so here or on its maker's servers: Sentiero only ever receives the text. If you switch location on, it stays in the diary here and goes nowhere.
scritte.La quarta cosa esce solo se lo decidi tu: A fourth thing leaves only if you decide so, and it is the key below: from then on the text needed to answer is sent to Anthropic, on your own account. Remove the key and it stops.
scritte.Copia di tutto te la fai da qui, quando: You can export a copy of everything from here, any time. Deleting the app deletes everything: no copy exists elsewhere to ask back for.
scritte.Tieni premuto il cerchio e parla, oppure: Press and hold the circle and speak, or type: it makes no difference. When you let go, what you said becomes today's entry.
scritte.Le cose che dici di voler fare non devi: You don't have to write down the things you say you want to do: they stay in the list on their own, and they stay until you do them. Nobody rushes you if a week goes by.
scritte.La sera trovi una riga su come stanno an: In the evening you find a line about how your days are going. In the morning there is another one, about yesterday. You cannot ask for them: they come when it is time.
scritte.Se una giornata è pesante, scrivilo pure: If a day is heavy, write it anyway. The app steps back: it draws no tasks from it and does not tell you how you are doing.
scritte.Qui sotto, in fondo, c'è «Dati»: da lì p: Further down there is «Data»: from there you take everything away in a file of your own. Do it now and then — it is the only copy that will ever exist.
scritte.Mettilo in Home: da qui l'iPhone può can: Add it to your Home Screen: from here, iPhone can erase what you write.
scritte.Prima però mettilo in Home: Condividi →: First though, add it to your Home Screen: Share → «Add to Home Screen». If you leave it in the browser, after a few days iPhone erases what you have written.
scritte.Suggerimento: aggiungilo alla schermata: Tip: add it to your Home Screen. It opens faster and works without a connection.
